title: Ahead of Paris mass, Pope Leo urges life together in 'dignity and peace'

blocks.text: PARIS, France—Pope Leo XIV said on Saturday it is possible to “live together in dignity and peace” as he met migrants in Paris. His statement comes ahead of a giant open-air mass expected to gather hundreds of thousands of people on the iconic Champs Elysees. The first US pontiff is visiting France on a four-day trip as the European nation gears up for elections next year to replace centrist President Emmanuel Macron, with the anti-immigration far right eyeing its best chance at the top job.
